description: This file is a shell script for managing and selecting iOS development teams and provisioning profiles. It detects and loads team IDs from various sources such as Xcode preferences, profiles, and keychain, and outputs a team ID based on preference logic.

methods.name: detect_python
methods.description: Detects available Python interpreter among candidates and sets the command to use.

methods.name: append_team
methods.description: Appends a team ID, free status, and name to internal arrays if not already present.

methods.name: load_teams_from_xcode_preferences
methods.description: Loads team IDs from Xcode preferences plist file, parsing JSON extracted by plutil.

methods.name: load_teams_from_legacy_defaults_key
methods.description: Loads team IDs from legacy defaults read command.

methods.name: load_teams_from_xcode_managed_profiles
methods.description: Loads team IDs from provisioning profile files in the user's mobile profiles directory.

methods.name: has_xcode_account
methods.description: Checks if an Xcode account exists with configured developer accounts.
